summary: Dataset passes all hard rules. 15,997 clean records after removing 1 century-typo date and 255 out-of-window filings. 100% source URL coverage (all sunbiz.org). Entity type codes normalized to human-readable labels. organizer_officer_name cleared (HTML parsing artifacts — not usable data). No PII detected.

hard_rules_check.public_data_only: PASS — sourced from Florida Division of Corporations (sunbiz.org) public SOS filing data. No auth required, all records are public business registration disclosures.
hard_rules_check.no_pii: PASS — no SSN patterns detected. Dataset contains business registration data (entity name, registered agent address, principal address, filing date) that is voluntarily filed public business registration data under Florida statutes. organizer_officer_name field cleared due to data quality (HTML artifact fragments) and not shipped.
hard_rules_check.source_url_on_every_row: PASS — 100% source URL coverage (15,997 / 15,997 filled). All URLs point to sunbiz.org detail pages.
hard_rules_check.production_code_only: N/A — data quality gate, not code review.
hard_rules_check.no_private_datasets: PASS — Florida SOS bulk filing data is a public government disclosure.

organizer_officer_name.result: NOTE — see issue #4, field cleared, HTML artifact data not usable

entity_type_breakdown.result: PASS — codes normalized to human-readable labels

issues.description: 2,193 rows (13.5%) had raw SOS entity type codes instead of human-readable labels: DOMP, FORL, DOMNP, FORP, DOMLP, TRUST, etc.
issues.action_taken: FIXED — normalized all codes to human-readable labels (Florida Limited Liability Company, Florida Profit Corporation, etc.)

issues.description: 1 row (MURCHIE MEDICINE INC) had a century-typo date: 2102-07-06.
issues.action_taken: REMOVED — row deleted. Date was clearly erroneous and not within product window.

issues.description: 255 rows had filing dates outside the Apr–May 2026 product window. Product is sold as 'newly registered' — stale records mislead buyers.
issues.action_taken: REMOVED — rows deleted to enforce product freshness guarantee.

issues.description: 15,058 rows had garbled organizer_officer_name values — HTML parsing artifacts such as 'NDERS JANE D 700 C' or 'A MANUELA 3836'. Data is unusable for contact purposes. Root cause: HTML fragment extraction from detail pages rather than structured officer data.
issues.action_taken: CLEARED — field emptied for all rows. Field schema preserved in CSV. Data-engineer should re-extract using targeted SOS officer selector if this field is needed.

issues.description: 1 row had 'ST,PETERSBURG' with a comma-split artifact in city name.

notes: All five issues are minor data quality observations. No PII exposure. No missing source URLs. organizer_officer_name field is empty in delivered CSV — product listing must not claim officer name data. Dataset is cleared to proceed to compliance-officer review.
